description: This file contains unit tests for a hash table implementation based on HashTableBase. It defines a wrapper class 'Int' for integers with counters for creation and destruction, a node struct 'TestHashNode', and a derived hash table class 'TestHashTable' with methods for insertion, deletion, and iteration. The file includes multiple test cases verifying construction, insertion, lookup, copying, moving, clearing, iteration, and erasure functionalities.

classes.name: Int
classes.description: A simple integer wrapper class that tracks creation and destruction counts.

classes.name: TestHashNode
classes.description: A node structure containing a pointer to an Int object, with methods to check null, tombstone, validity, and hash value.

classes.name: TestHashTable
classes.description: A hash table class derived from HashTableBase, managing ownership of Int pointers, with methods for insertion, deletion, containment check, iteration, and clearing.

methods.name: Int::ResetCounters
methods.description: Resets global counters for creation and destruction of Int objects.

methods.name: TestHashTable::contains
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the hash table.

methods.name: TestHashTable::insert
methods.description: Inserts a value into the hash table.

methods.name: TestHashTable::erase
methods.description: Removes a value from the hash table.

methods.name: TestHashTable::clear
methods.description: Removes all items from the hash table.
